latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the New Manager Onboarding Kit.

- Provides concrete 30/60/90-day plans tailored for newly promoted or hired managers.
- Includes workflows for context scanning, stakeholder mapping, listening tours, and drafting team charters.
- Delivers templates for 1:1 meetings, team rituals, early wins, and meeting scripts.
- Emphasizes listening, trust-building, and adaptive management styles.
- Outlines clear guardrails: no HR, legal, medical, or diagnostic advice; privacy and safety protected.
